mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Federal Funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals a strong accommodative monetary policy, which typically leads to increased liquidity in the market and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS declines over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% within a month signals a weakening in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST decreases by more than 10% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 2% over 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL increases by more than 2% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real GDP (GDPC1) and increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 decreases and UNRATE increases simultaneously.
